races.name: Nags Head Cutting British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
WALKIN ON THE MOON showed ability in a couple of warm maidens and he can make his experience count in what is probably a moderate novice for the track. Great Balls O'Fire makes most appeal of the newcomers but the market will offer clues.

  1. WALKIN ON THE MOON (IRE)
  2. GREAT BALLS O'FIRE
  3. ONE FOR BRUCE

races.name: Twyford Down Cutting Handicap
races.verdict:
PILU has been shaping up well this season and is capable of winning off his current mark if things drop his way. Rajaking looked better than ever when beating 20 rivals at York last month so is another to consider along with in-form course specialist Spring Bloom.

  1. PILU (IRE)
  2. RAJAKING
  3. SPRING BLOOM

races.name: Hargreaves Services PLC Handicap
races.verdict:
NAPOLIAN looked unlucky at Doncaster last week and can quickly make amends with just a 1 lb nudge. Guest House is second choice ahead of Khuskhas.

  1. NAPOLIAN (IRE)
  2. GUEST HOUSE (IRE)
  3. KHUSKHAS

races.name: Hopeful Stakes (Sponsored By Blackwell Earthmoving) (Listed)
races.verdict:
July Cup sixth PRINCE OF INDIA ran another mighty race when second in the Hungerford Stakes last week and can deservedly get back to winning ways. Words of Truth is 4-7 and could have even more to offer in the coming months so is feared most.

  1. PRINCE OF INDIA (IRE)
  2. WORDS OF TRUTH
  3. ELARAK

races.name: 200,000 Tattersalls Somerville Auction Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Eve Johnson Houghton looks to have a strong hand here with NIGHT IN VEGAS, who has useful form to his name in better company than this, the one to beat. Zigazig Ah has already bagged a valuable pot this summer and she can be a factor over 6f, with Everatease, a stablemate of the selection, also of interest.

  1. NIGHT IN VEGAS (IRE)
  2. ZIGAZIG AH
  3. EVERATEASE

races.name: Blackwell Earthmoving 70th Anniversary Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Preference is for PEARL RIVER who soon got back on track returned to a longer trip when fifth at Goodwood last time. With this extra distance promising to suit, the 3-y-o gets the vote ahead of the in-form Goblet of Fire, with last year's winner of the race Arqoob also considered.

  1. PEARL RIVER
  2. GOBLET OF FIRE
  3. ARQOOB (IRE)

races.name: Polhill Cutting Handicap
races.verdict:
DIOMED DUKE returned to winning ways in good style at Lingfield last month and a 5 lb rise back up in the weights might not be enough to prevent him going in again. Tiva landed this race last year and is feared most arriving on the back of a success at Musselburgh, the only 3-y-o in the line-up Lara Antipova also a contender.

  1. DIOMED DUKE
  2. TIVA (IRE)
  3. LARA ANTIPOVA

races.name: Sky Bet Strensall Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
GERYON has been going the right way this year, bagging a Leopardstown Group 3 last month before beaten only by a fellow progressive 3-y-o at Goodwood, so he is taken to resume winning ways back down in trip. Persica has been holding his form well this summer and could be the main danger, ahead of Archivist who resumed his progress on his latest outing.

  1. GERYON (IRE)
  2. PERSICA (IRE)
  3. ARCHIVIST

races.name: Sky Bet Melrose Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A typically competitive renewal of the Melrose which can go the way of INFRAAD, William Haggas' progressive son of Ghaiyyath having looked an ideal candidate for this race with his gutsy victory at Goodwood. Glory Road has some strong form to his name across his qualifying runs and made a successful handicap debut at Newcastle last time, so is also high on the shortlist, with wide-margin Galway winner Vantage Code also holding strong claims in a race where it's hard to rule many out.

  1. INFRAAD (IRE)
  2. GLORY ROAD (GER)
  3. VANTAGE CODE (IRE)

races.name: Sky Bet City Of York Stakes (Group 1)
races.verdict:
With plenty of pace in the field, this could set up perfectly for NOTABLE SPEECH to claim a sixth top-level success. Lake Forest is arguably a better horse than when second in this corresponding event 12 months ago, and he's feared along with Rogue Diplomat, who shaped very well when just a neck behind him in the Lennox. Ten Bob Tony is enjoying a fine season and deserves a place on the shortlist for this fascinating renewal.

  1. NOTABLE SPEECH
  2. LAKE FOREST
  3. ROGUE DIPLOMAT (IRE)

races.name: Sky Bet Ebor Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
LOVE ME TENDER runs in the same colours as the recent Willie Mullins-trained winners of this and there's a good chance the reason he's yet to see the track for his new connections has been to preserve his mark for this. Klassleader had firm ground as a possible excuse in the Old Newton Cup and this course winner is taken to resume his progression and provide the main threat. Daiquiri Bay and Emit also make the shortlist, with Real Dream one who could go well at likely bigger odds.

  1. LOVE ME TENDER (GER)
  2. KLASSLEADER
  3. DAIQUIRI BAY

races.name: Sky Bet Constantine Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
races.verdict:
DANCE IN THE STORM resumed her impressive progress despite being on the wrong end of the draw again when adding another 7f success to her tally at Chester 3 weeks ago, doing very well having come from last and wide. She's long since suggested a try at sprinting could see her to even better effect and is fancied to prove the point from a 4 lb higher mark. Stewards' Cup scorer Evening Saigon, Wednesday's course winner Air Force One and Pocklington head the dangers. Sondad is another in the mix.

  1. DANCE IN THE STORM
  2. EVENING SAIGON (IRE)
  3. AIR FORCE ONE (IRE)

races.name: Julia Graves Roses Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
The progressive ADONIUS has a run style that suggests he'll be well suited to York and, with his versatility regarding ground another plus, he's a relatively straightforward choice to come out on top. Dance A Jig's recent nursery success at Haydock is supported by the timefigure and he's respected back up in grade, while Hickory Lad and Dorigo are others capable of being in the shake-up.

  1. ADONIUS (IRE)
  2. DANCE A JIG
  3. HICKORY LAD (IRE)

races.name: Sky Bet Dav Reid Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Lots with chances in a cracking finale but ERZINDJAN is fancied to build on a promising sixth in the Royal Hunt Cup now back up in trip and capitalise on a handy-looking mark. John Smith's Cup hero Raammee rates a big threat with few miles still on the clock, while several others also can play a prominent role, notably Al Aali, Thunder Run, Diego El Queso and last year's winner Dain Ma Nut In.

  1. ERZINDJAN (IRE)
  2. RAAMMEE
  3. AL AALI (FR)

meeting_summary.going: Good-good to firm in places on round course

races.name: Coolmore Stud St Mark's Basilica Irish European Breeders Fund Maiden
races.verdict:
A maiden for newcomers so the market will offer plenty of clues. MONOGRAM holds an entry for the Dewhurst and is bred to excel over this sort of trip, so he is a tentative selection for a stable that won this 3 years ago. Iveagh House is well entered up and looks the pick of Aidan O'Brien's pair, while Hazaraf, War Artist and Selosse also hold lofty Group 1 entries.

  1. MONOGRAM
  2. IVEAGH HOUSE (IRE)
  3. HAZARAF (IRE)

races.name: Moloney's Bar And Music Venue Maiden
races.verdict:
HANDANI has made a promising start to his career, beaten only by one who had already shown useful form at Leopardstown on his return, and he is taken to get off the mark as he goes further up in trip. The main danger could be Acula, who offered plenty to work on making her recent debut, with Saxony Charms completing the shortlist.

  1. HANDANI (IRE)
  2. ACULA (IRE)
  3. SAXONY CHARMS (IRE)

races.name: Mitsubishi Electric Handicap
races.verdict:
GENESIS has a fine record in sprint handicaps here this year and might be able to land another win. Chicago Pope was fourth in a very warm 3-y-o-only race at York when last seen in June and heads the many dangers along with fellow 3-y-o Gavoo and Eddie Lynam's Keke.

  1. GENESIS (IRE)
  2. CHICAGO POPE (IRE)
  3. GAVOO (IRE)

races.name: Alpha Centauri Debutante Stakes (Fillies' Group 2)
races.verdict:
ALPHA only scraped home from Dancing Destiny in the Silver Flash but the impression she made when slamming some useful opposition in a C&D maiden prior to that is still fresh in the memory and she can prove too strong for Green Empress, who gave Sun Goddess something to think about in a 6f course Group 2 last time.

  1. ALPHA (IRE)
  2. GREEN EMPRESS (IRE)
  3. DANCING DESTINY (IRE)

races.name: Coolmore Stud City Of Troy Tom Cooper Irish European Breeders Fund Futurity Stakes (Group 2)
races.verdict:
Aidan O'Brien has dominated this Group 2 over the years and GIANT SEQUOIA can take the step up in class in his stride on the back of his impressive success in a C&D maiden at the end of June. Chesham winner Nola Soul may provide a bigger threat than the selection's Group 3-winning stablemate Florida Bay.

  1. GIANT SEQUOIA (USA)
  2. NOLA SOUL (USA)
  3. FLORIDA BAY (IRE)

races.name: Neville O'Byrne Memorial Irish European Breeders Fund Fillies Handicap
races.verdict:
NAVY WATERS rates just the pick of the weights so is fancied to gain a first win of 2026 at the chief expense of Yousaynothingatall who looks a big threat on the back of a clear second here. Vanir and Marazion can also play a prominent role in this competitive handicap.

  1. NAVY WATERS (IRE)
  2. YOUSAYNOTHINGATALL (IRE)
  3. VANIR (IRE)

races.name: Comer Group International Irish St. Leger Trial Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
CARMERS couldn't live with the very best stayers in the Gold Cup at Royal Ascot but he's the one to beat back in calmer waters. Kizlyar, who runs here instead of the Ebor at York, had the form of his Ascot Stakes success boosted by stablemate Defiantly's comfortable win at Glorious Goodwood and he may provide a bigger threat than the returning Queenstown.

  1. CARMERS (IRE)
  2. KIZLYAR (IRE)
  3. QUEENSTOWN (IRE)

races.name: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
races.verdict:
A huge field with SOULFUL DIVA taken to get her head back in front after a good showing over 5f here last week. Recent C&D 1-2 Mint Man and Hugo's Girl should figure prominently again, while Poweracclaim surely has a handicap like this in him judged on his last 2 showings.

  1. SOULFUL DIVA (IRE)
  2. MINT MAN
  3. HUGO'S GIRL (IRE)

races.name: Pink Lady Find Your Fizz Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Low mileage 4-y-o CLOTH OF GOLD did about as well as possible under the circumstances in a better race considering a less-than-ideal trip at Southwell on his most recent outing and is taken to capitalise on this marked drop in grade. Mwafaq continues to thrive and seems sure to be on the premises again with this easy 1¼m likely to be within range. Moonrunner has been freshened up after a poor run at Yarmouth and is also interesting, for all that he may be better suited by a more galloping track.

  1. CLOTH OF GOLD (IRE)
  2. MWAFAQ (IRE)
  3. MOONRUNNER

races.name: North Downs Hospital Handicap
races.verdict:
CRAZY PLAN has made a pleasing start to life in handicap company and a race of this nature seems well within her compass. Dijon Gone drops in grade back from a break and looks the main threat.

  1. CRAZY PLAN
  2. DIJON GONE
  3. LADY OF CLOVER (IRE)

races.name: Advance Online Digital Media Group Handicap
races.verdict:
LAST TRUMP looks to have got into handicaps on a handy mark judged on the strength of his debut form, so he's put forward as the answer with the longer trip likely to suit. Hebridean Nomad was in good form when last seen at the beginning of the year and is an obvious danger returning from a 6-month absence with his yard very much among the winners. Mountbatten also merits consideration.

  1. LAST TRUMP
  2. HEBRIDEAN NOMAD
  3. MOUNTBATTEN (GER)

races.name: Spa At The Marriott Lingfield Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
NORHAM was getting the message late on his debut at Chepstow last month and strikes as the type to take a big step forward now upped to a trip more in keeping with his pedigree, so it’s reasonable to believe he could improve past standard-setter Eighth Immortal. Mount St is another likely improver and also needs considering.

  1. NORHAM (IRE)
  2. EIGHTH IMMORTAL (IRE)
  3. MOUNT ST (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap
races.verdict:
The potential for a slowly-run race tempers confidence, but the vote goes to DANNICK, who is probably still ahead of his mark following an unlucky second at Southwell last time. Timely Affair could be the danger.

  1. DANNICK
  2. TIMELY AFFAIR
  3. LADY MANZOR

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On X Handicap
races.verdict:
HARRY BROWN has plenty in his favour and can land the finale. What A Tahoo looks the pick of the remainder.

  1. HARRY BROWN
  2. WHAT A TAHOO (IRE)
  3. RECON MISSION (IRE)

races.name: Celebrating National Racehorse Week Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KING’S SCHOLAR needs to sharpen up in the jumping department, but he’s still made an encouraging start to his hurdling career and gets the nod to complete the hat-trick back from a break with the potential to raise his game further based on his good-quality Flat form. Whermyrosemarygoes had more in hand than the final margin suggests on her recent hurdling debut at Uttoxeter and looks the obvious threat.

  1. KING'S SCHOLAR (IRE)
  2. WHERMYROSEMARYGOES (IRE)
  3. PLAYFUL FOX (FR)

races.name: Happy 80th Birthday John Lane Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
SIR CARNEGIE looked better than ever when going in at Hexham and is worth forgiving an uncharacteristic poor display at Market Rasen since so gets the vote. C&D scorer Honey I'm Good could emerge as the main danger with Rian Corcoran an eye-catching booking, while My Girl Katie has a good record round here and can also play a prominent role.

  1. SIR CARNEGIE (IRE)
  2. HONEY I'M GOOD (IRE)
  3. MY GIRL KATIE (IRE)

races.name: Philip Wilson Memorial Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Three-time hurdle winner ICE JET's chase debut form at Uttoxeter looks strong and with improvement anticipated in this sphere, Dan Skelton's 4-y-o is fancied to take full advantage of his handy weight-for-age allowance. That said, Gore Point arrives on a roll and ought to give the selection plenty to think about in his bid for a 4-timer.

  1. ICE JET (IRE)
  2. GORE POINT
  3. COBBLER'S BOY (IRE)

races.name: Torbay Weekly Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
This may well go to a stable switcher, with UNCLE REMUS preferred to Lakefield Flyer. Recent C&D winner Mi Sueno also needs considering, along with Ugo Bingo.

  1. UNCLE REMUS
  2. LAKEFIELD FLYER (IRE)
  3. MI SUENO (IRE)

races.name: Aubrey Loze Memorial Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
LETTERSTON LILY returned an improved model when successful at Perth in April and is fancied to resume winning ways back over a more suitable trip. Returning Handlethekettle merits plenty of respect, along with consistent course winner Morning Mayhem.

  1. LETTERSTON LILY
  2. HANDLETHEKETTLE (IRE)
  3. MORNING MAYHEM

races.name: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
LUNAR ORBIT may add to Dan Skelton's plentiful success with stable switchers this summer. Mojito des Mottes and Max of Stars both look very credible dangers.

  1. LUNAR ORBIT (IRE)
  2. MOJITO DES MOTTES (FR)
  3. MAX OF STARS (FR)

races.name: Every Race Live On Racing TV EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CALLISTERRA stepped forward from her debut when runner-up over C&D last time and she can go one better. Green Bay Dream is also considered after back-to-back placed efforts at Ripon, whilst On Golden Pond produced a promising debut effort at Newcastle and is also respected now on turf.

  1. CALLISTERRA (IRE)
  2. GREEN BAY DREAM
  3. ON GOLDEN POND (IRE)

races.name: Watch Racing TV Now Selling Stakes
races.verdict:
BIGALO arrives here after several good efforts in defeat and a reproduction of his latest pair of Musselburgh seconds could be enough to see him go one better. Amantha looks the main threat in a thin race.

  1. BIGALO
  2. AMANTHA (IRE)
  3. MALENY (IRE)

races.name: Marske Fabrications And Engineering Handicap
races.verdict:
QUEEN TAMARA looks very well treated on the form of her final juvenile start and can make her first start outside of her age group a winning one. Rajapour brushed off a nasty incident at York with a good effort at Hamilton 3 weeks ago and is also shortlisted, with stablemate Kaleido also considered.

  1. QUEEN TAMARA (IRE)
  2. RAJAPOUR (IRE)
  3. KALEIDO

races.name: Bakers Tailoring Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
MIGHTY QUIET has returned to the mark she won off at Windsor just under a year ago and is preferred to Poppeye and Fille Imbassee.

  1. MIGHTY QUIET
  2. POPPEYE
  3. FILLE IMBASSEE

races.name: Bakers Tailoring Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Harriet Bethell 3-y-o ALWAYS BLUE is given a chance to build on her promising handicap debut third at Wolverhampton. Fellow 3-y-o Ceinture d'Orion is second choice ahead of Yafaarr.

  1. ALWAYS BLUE
  2. CEINTURE D'ORION
  3. YAFAARR (IRE)

races.name: Market Cross Jewellers Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
INGLEBY ARCHIE has quickly returned to only 1 lb above the mark he defied at Nottingham earlier in the summer. Mr Cool arrives on the back of a win and third at Ayr in recent weeks and ought to figure prominently again, while Missmimi is also respected on the back of her solid reappearance.

  1. INGLEBY ARCHIE (IRE)
  2. MR COOL (IRE)
  3. MISSMIMI

races.name: Market Cross Jewellers Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
MEN OF HONOUR is potentially well treated on his Irish form. He could be worth chancing in an open-looking sprint, especially if the market speaks in his favour following a breathing operation. Irish Nectar is lurking on a dangerous mark and could capitalise if enough rain arrives, while the Paul Midgley pair both make appeal.

  1. MEN OF HONOUR (IRE)
  2. IRISH NECTAR
  3. SPEEDING BULLET (IRE)

races.name: Celebrate National Racehorse Week Handicap
races.verdict:
Two-time course winner MRS TRUMP may capitalise on an attractive mark with Jason Hart taking over. Little Beck Annie is less exposed than most in this field and feared most. Sparkling Wine, Multaneighttothree and Drish Samphire complete the shortlist.

  1. MRS TRUMP (IRE)
  2. LITTLE BECK ANNIE
  3. SPARKLING WINE

races.name: Virgin Bet Supports Safe Gambling Handicap
races.verdict:
Lots with chances but it could pay to side with RHOSCOLYN to end a losing run and capitalise on a lenient mark now that ground conditions have swung in his favour. George Boughey's improving Asuka rates a major danger though in his bid to gain a fourth success from five starts to date. Collecting Coin, Goldmoyne and Vixey also need factoring in.

  1. RHOSCOLYN
  2. ASUKA
  3. COLLECTING COIN

races.name: Virgin Bet Chester Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
BY THE BOOK comes here on the back of a good Beverley second in similar company and looks to have been found a very good opportunity to resume winning ways. Lazy Griff wasn't at his best in the Goodwood Cup but still rates much the biggest threat down in class, while Lady Vivian and Fantasy World appeal as the pick of the rest for minor honours.

  1. BY THE BOOK (IRE)
  2. LAZY GRIFF (GER)
  3. LADY VIVIAN (IRE)

races.name: Powells Jewellery EBF Fillies' Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
NICELY holds the edge on form and with this return to 6f also a plus she is taken to quickly resume winning ways. George Boughey's Takaaful made a promising start when fourth in a Newbury maiden and looks open to plenty of improvement so could prove the main danger ahead of Bated Benevolence and Gladys Pugh.

  1. NICELY (IRE)
  2. TAKAAFUL
  3. BATED BENEVOLENCE

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
George Boughey's Night Of Thunder debutante IVORY MOON fetched 700,000 guineas as a yearling and holds a Group 1 Cheveley Park entry so is taken to make a winning start at the chief expense of Newcastle debut third Mollisha. Angel Ceecee is another newcomer who could have a say.

  1. IVORY MOON (IRE)
  2. MOLLISHA (IRE)
  3. ANGEL CEECEE

races.name: Kore Systems Handicap
races.verdict:
U S S CHARLESTON shaped as though the return to this trip would suit when fading late into fourth over 6f at Brighton last time so looks the way to go. In-form Hanney Girl appeals as the one to chase him home ahead of Alfa Duplicate who is handily drawn to attack.

  1. U S S CHARLESTON
  2. HANNEY GIRL
  3. ALFA DUPLICATE (IRE)

races.name: Powells Jewellery Handicap
races.verdict:
No shortage of chances but ROMAN DRAGON finds himself back down to his last winning mark having found his stamina stretched tackling 7f on each of his last 2 starts around here and, from a handy draw, he could well be ready to make a bold bid to enhance his already fine record on the Roodee. Easy Wolverhampton scorer American Style, and course specialist Rosenpur head the dangers, whilst a strong pace could bring Cherry Baker into things late in the piece.

  1. ROMAN DRAGON
  2. AMERICAN STYLE
  3. ROSENPUR (GER)

races.name: Celebrate National Racehorse Week Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
SEA AND SUN couldn't build on the promise he displayed in novice/maidens at the first attempt in handicaps at Goodwood 24 days ago but he still appeals as a staying handicapper to keep on the right side of this season so he shades preference in receipt of weight all round. St Mawes shaped much better than the distance beaten suggests over a marathon trip last time and he's a big threat under Billy Loughnane. Midnight Rumble completes the shortlist.

  1. SEA AND SUN
  2. ST MAWES (IRE)
  3. MIDNIGHT RUMBLE

races.name: ML Lynch Civil Engineering Ltd. Maiden Hurdle (Div 1)
races.verdict:
AIRDS MOSS landed the odds in a weak bumper here in May but he'd shown up well when runner-up in a stronger one on his debut and could be up to making a successful start over hurdles. Kingstonian and Reaching High are also a couple of interesting newcomers to this sphere based on their useful Flat form, while Minella Hollow had excuses on his recent comeback at Roscommon and remains with potential.

  1. AIRDS MOSS (IRE)
  2. KINGSTONIAN
  3. REACHING HIGH (IRE)

races.name: ML Lynch Civil Engineering Ltd. Maiden Hurdle (Div 2)
races.verdict:
GOLDEN HANDSHAKE was in the process of making a very promising start to his hurdling career until unseating rider late at Galway 3 weeks ago and on that evidence, he can win a maiden such as this. Sea Eagle and Minella Moon Shine head the opposition.

  1. GOLDEN HANDSHAKE
  2. SEA EAGLE
  3. MINELLA MOON SHINE (IRE)

races.name: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
A chance is taken on SILIN ALAINN, who hasn’t shown a great deal over hurdles but has a handicap mark to reflect that, and her switch to a top, in-form yard with a good record with similar sorts is well worth taking seriously in what looks a modest handicap hurdle. Uptaurintop arrives in good form and appeals as the one most likely to take advantage should the selection fail to fire, with both Tedworth and The Border Boy also respected.

  1. SILIN ALAINN (IRE)
  2. UPTAURINTOP (IRE)
  3. TEDWORTH (IRE)
  4. THE BORDER BOY (IRE)

races.name: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
JUPITER DU GITE went close at this course last time and, from just a 3 lb higher mark, looks capable of going one better, with the step up in trip unlikely to be an issue. Hees Dynamite posted a career-best over this C&D last month and is likely to prove the biggest threat, while Duke Silver is also respected.

  1. JUPITER DU GITE (FR)
  2. HEES DYNAMITE (IRE)
  3. DUKE SILVER (IRE)

races.name: Moynihan Scaffolding Ltd. And The Warehouse Cafe Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
A useful contest in store with DADDY LONG LEGS sure to have been expertly prepared for this chasing debut, so he can get the better of Bowensonfire. Putapoundinthejar won the Galway Hurdle last month so switches to the larger obstacles at the top of his game.

  1. DADDY LONG LEGS (FR)
  2. BOWENSONFIRE (FR)
  3. PUTAPOUNDINTHEJAR (IRE)

races.name: Old Market Lane Traders Novice Chase
races.verdict:
BUTCH CASSIDY bounced back from having bled to win impressively by 9 lengths over this C&D in May and is taken to follow up after a break. Emily Love created a good impression at Tramore in May and rates the main danger, ahead of Uncle Pat, who has the ability to win this but is better suited by longer trips and a more extreme test of stamina.

  1. BUTCH CASSIDY (IRE)
  2. EMILY LOVE (IRE)
  3. UNCLE PAT (IRE)

races.name: Canella Lane Handicap Chase (Listed)
races.verdict:
BOSTON ROVER made big strides over fences last season and, with his recent return under his belt, is taken to resume progress and get back to winning ways. Jalila Moriviere has been knocking on the door of late and should appreciate the drop in trip after failing to stay at Galway last time, while Solitary Man can’t be ruled out back at his favoured venue.

  1. BOSTON ROVER (IRE)
  2. JALILA MORIVIERE (FR)
  3. SOLITARY MAN (IRE)

races.name: Laurels Pub (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
TEOFIL showed a good attitude to make his second bumper outing a winning one at Galway last month, despite his rider reporting the saddle slipped, and looks the one to beat under a penalty. Emergency Man bumped into one that's gone in again since on his debut here 5 weeks ago and can provide the main threat, ahead of Rokanako, who's already been beaten under a penalty.

  1. TEOFIL (IRE)
  2. EMERGENCY MAN (IRE)
  3. ROKANAKO (IRE)

races.name: Race 10 - Ballston Spa Stakes Presented By STIHL - Grade 2
Race 11 - Alabama Stakes Presented By Keeneland Sales - Grade 1
Race 9 - Del Mar Oaks Presented By Keeneland Sales - Grade 1
Race 11 - Del Mar Mile Stakes - Grade 2
Prix Du Bourg Saint-leonard Claiming Stakes - Awt
